i.norm: Verifies that passing an empty options array to the constructor causes the unescaper to default to semiColonRequired mode. The input is "&#x" followed by seven null characters (the default value for a newly created char array). Null characters are not valid hex digits, and there is no trailing semicolon, so the entity is considered incomplete. As a result, translate() copies the entire input through unchanged.
Passing zero options forces the constructor to use the semiColonRequired default.

The first three chars form the hex-entity prefix "&#x". The remaining seven positions keep their Java default value '�' (null char). '�' is not a valid hex digit, so the parser cannot extract an entity value. With semiColonRequired active and no ';' found, translate() returns 0 at every position and the input is returned verbatim.
